invariants.rationale: The method returns a List<WriteStatus> produced by JavaBulkInsertHelper.bulkInsert(), which is expected to always return a non-null list.
Clustering is parallelized over positive number of output groups for a meaningful clustering operation.
The method passes inputRecords to bulkInsert, so it must be non-null.
instantTime is used as a commit identifier, so it must be non-null.
Each WriteStatus typically corresponds to an output file or group; there shouldn't be more WriteStatus objects than input records.
